So the area is (1/2) * s * sqrt(3)s/(1 + sqrt(3)) = (sqrt(3)/2) * s^2/(1 + sqrt(3)). Also s^2 = 1 + sqrt(3), therefore the area = sqrt(3)/2.

method.method_draft: Coordinate/line-intersection route: From the diagram/text, place the square with A=(0,0), B=(s,0), D=(0,s), where s=AB=\sqrt{1+\sqrt3}. Since triangle ABE is equilateral and E is inside the square, AE makes a 60° angle with AB, so line AE has equation y=\sqrt3 x. Diagonal BD has equation y=s-x. Solve \sqrt3 x=s-x to get F=(s/(1+\sqrt3), \sqrt3 s/(1+\sqrt3)). The area of triangle ABF is one half times base AB=s times the height of F above AB, namely \sqrt3 s/(1+\sqrt3). Thus area = \frac12 s\cdot \frac{\sqrt3 s}{1+\sqrt3}=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\cdot \frac{s^2}{1+\sqrt3}. Substitute s^2=1+\sqrt3 to obtain \frac{\sqrt3}{2}.

method.method_draft: Angle/law-of-sines route: Use triangle ABF directly. Because ABE is equilateral, angle BAF=angle BAE=60°. Since BF lies on diagonal BD of the square, the angle between BA and BF is 45°, so angle ABF=45°. Therefore angle AFB=75°. Let s=AB=\sqrt{1+\sqrt3}. By the Law of Sines in triangle ABF, AF/sin45° = AB/sin75°, so AF=s\,sin45°/sin75°. The area is \frac12\cdot AB\cdot AF\cdot sin60° = \frac12 s^2\frac{\sin45°\sin60°}{\sin75°}. Substitute s^2=1+\sqrt3, sin60°=\sqrt3/2, and sin45°/sin75°=\sqrt3-1. Then the area is \frac12(1+\sqrt3)(\sqrt3/2)(\sqrt3-1)=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}.

推理：在三角形 ABF 中，因为 ABE 是等边三角形，AF 在 AE 上，所以角 BAF = 角 BAE = 60°。又因为 BF 在正方形的对角线 BD 上，而 BA 是正方形的一条边，正方形对角线与边成 45°，所以角 ABF = 45°。因此角 AFB = 180° - 60° - 45° = 75°。

设 s = AB = sqrt(1 + sqrt(3))。由正弦定理，AF / sin45° = AB / sin75°，所以 AF = s sin45° / sin75°。

三角形 ABF 的面积为 (1/2) * AB * AF * sin60° = (1/2) * s^2 * sin45° * sin60° / sin75°。

代入 s^2 = 1 + sqrt(3)，sin60° = sqrt(3)/2，并且 sin45° / sin75° = sqrt(3) - 1，得到面积 = (1/2)(1 + sqrt(3))(sqrt(3)/2)(sqrt(3) - 1)。因为 (1 + sqrt(3))(sqrt(3) - 1) = 2，所以面积 = sqrt(3)/2。
